name: Pacifidlog Town
lines:
Er-hem!
Allow me to introduce myself...
The Pokémon Fan Club’s most
important person, the chairman...
...is my older brother.
I’m here enjoying my vacation with
Pokémon, yes indeed.

It’s clearly very friendly toward you.
A Pokémon that adoring and adorable
deserves a TM like this, no?

Hmm...
It’s not bad, but it’s also not good.
You, as the Trainer, need to put in
some more effort.

It has a vicious look to it.
A frightening Pokémon like that
deserves a TM like this.

If a Pokémon is very friendly toward you,
Return’s power is enhanced.
If it’s not friendly, Frustration’s power
goes up.

It appears to be very friendly
with its Trainer.

It doesn’t appear to be friendly
with its Trainer...
